study type: Quantitative study with qualitative case study data
exposure: Prenatal care type (MCHs, group prenatal care, freestanding birth centers)
Strong Start group prenatal care participants
cohort: Over 45,000 Medicaid beneficiaries who participated in the Strong Start for Mothers and Newborns prenatal care initiative from 2013 to 2017.
finding: After controlling for clinical, demographic, and psychosocial risks, Strong Start birth center participants had significantly lower rates of preterm birth, low birthweight, and cesarean section compared to MCH participants.
mod_finding: Strong Start birth center participants had significantly lower rates of cesarean section compared to MCH participants.
